description: Declared mutants of the text Module batch (docs/architecture/target/v2/text-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 8.7; ids tg- the TX-1 guard script, tx<N>- Design Invariant TX-<N> of target/v2/text.zh-Hant.md). Written with the tests; the adversarial check of the catalog (Opus/high, same model as the author while Fable is paused) is recorded in the merge approval page. Not kept (equivalent under every input, checked by hand 2026-11-23): drawing glyphs marked invisible (an invisible glyph is HarfBuzz's invisible glyph id, which FreeType cannot draw, or a space; a probe of the Kana font alone, which has no U+0020, shows "\n\t" as the invisible id with HarfBuzz's fallback space advance, not .notdef); FreeType's unscaled advance read without FT_LOAD_NO_SCALE (with no size set FreeType returns the same font units); FreeType built with FT_CONFIG_OPTION_ENVIRONMENT_PROPERTIES (the environment case rasterizes BIZ UDPGothic and the CFF Kana font with FREETYPE_PROPERTIES set and gets the same pixels: the TrueType interpreter, the CFF engine and stem darkening are set again with FT_Property_Set after FT_Init_FreeType, and the fonts are hinted by the auto-hinter, whose script and x-height properties changed nothing here; the #undef stays as a second line of defence). Not added as mutants, tests only: the padding counted when a glyph is too large (the mutant writes past the page, undefined behaviour) and TooLarge counted again for a cached glyph (no single-edit mutant). Not testable with these fonts, review: the language HarfBuzz is given (ShapeOptions::language, or "und"; no test font has language-specific forms, and the process locale is "C" in tests) and FT_LOAD_NO_BITMAP (no test font has embedded bitmaps). Adversarial check (Opus/high, same model as the author while Fable is paused, 2026-11-23): build/evidence/gyo2-sdl-text/mutation-check.md. Retired 2026-11-23 with the user's decision v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-t question B (the guard keeps the Engine side only): tg-plugins-not-scanned and the self-test it checked.
